items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: Meroff had his wife, Florence... she called and asked if I would come back

ctx.x: And, that really erked him to no end and we were both very sorry that we flared up because I had a great amount of respect for him - one of the finest band leaders I ever worked for and generous, as well. So, uh, I got--- I was hot-headed too as a kid and I quit and I went back to Chicago. And, so, that ended Meroff - Meroff had his wife, Florence---
